title: package.json expectations
description: Configuration rules every workspace package manifest must obey.

name.description: Packages must be scoped under @monorepo/ and match the module folder name.

rules.message: Use 'pnpm run build:ts' instead of invoking tsc directly.
Use 'pnpm run test:unit' instead of calling vite directly.
The module-level build script should be 'tsc -b' so pnpm has a single build entry point.
Run tests through the workspace helper so filters stay consistent.

rules.name: typescript
rules.message: TypeScript belongs at the workspace root; drop it from package devDependencies.

rules.name: vitest
rules.message: Vitest should only be installed at the workspace root; remove it here.
Internal dependencies must use workspace:* specifiers to keep versions in sync.

references.message: We rely on workspace references instead of per-package TypeScript installs; remove local references.
